_comment: Re-baselined by task 39, which rescues annotator-only CDS calls into the merged GFF. Measured on INT-ANIMAL-01: CDS 13 (9 miniprot + 4 rescued: ATP8, ND3, ND4L, ND6), tRNA 20, rRNA 2, 0 cds_crosscheck conflicts, protein_coding_completeness 1.0. Task 38's prior baseline was CDS 9. required_protein_coding asserts the genes are reported *found* (absent from protein_coding_genes_missing) rather than present in cds_rescued, so it stays valid if miniprot itself later calls them — the floors above cannot catch a silent regression to 'ATP8 missing'.
